title: Network pharmacology and molecular docking reveal the multi-target mechanisms of Paeoniae Radix Rubra in functional angiogenesis: Synergistic regulation of ADAM10-NOTCH and VEGFR2-PI3K/AKT signaling.
authors: Zhang, Rong; Hu, Runxuan; Wang, Yunze; Jiang, Haoyan; Aheniyazi, Aliyanmu; Tao, Jing; Li, Jinyao; Yang, Yining
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究中药赤芍促血管生成的多靶点机制，虽涉及分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Therapeutic angiogenesis has emerged as a paradigm-shifting approach for vascular occlusive diseases, such as PAD, stroke and CTO. Paeoniae Radix Rubra (PRR), a traditional Chinese herb, is the dried root of Paeonia lactiflora Pall. and Paeonia veitchii Lyncha. It has shown potential in cardiovascular protection. However, its pro-angiogenic mechanisms remain poorly understood. AIMS OF THE STUDY: The aim of this study was to investigate the pro-angiogenic mechanisms of PRR and evaluate its potential as a therapeutic agent for vascular occlusive diseases. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Network pharmacology and molecular docking were used to predict and analyze the potential molecular targets of PRR. HUVECs were used to assess the effects of PRR on cell proliferation, migration, tube formation and 3D sprouting. Additionally, a murine hindlimb ischemia model was employed to assess the therapeutic efficacy of PRR in restoring blood flow and promoting vascular regeneration. RESULTS: PRR dose-dependently enhanced endothelial cell proliferation, migration, and tube formation, while restoring ischemic limb perfusion to 93.5 % of baseline and increasing mature vessel density. Mechanistically, PRR upregulated VEGFR2 and ADAM10, activating PI3K/AKT signaling and ADAM10 mediated vascular remodeling. shRNA perturbation studies revealed that ADAM10 knockdown reduced PRR's efficacy by half, while its overexpression amplified angiogenesis driven by PRR. CONCLUSION: PRR functions as a multi-target angiogenic agent by coordinately activating VEGFR2/PI3K/AKT survival signaling and ADAM10 mediated vascular remodeling, overcoming the limitations of single-target therapies. This natural product synergy enables simultaneous endothelial sprouting and vascular stabilization, positioning PRR as a paradigm-shifting candidate for complex occlusive diseases.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：治疗性血管生成已成为血管闭塞性疾病（如PAD、卒中和CTO）的一种范式转变性方法。赤芍（PRR）是一种传统中草药，为芍药（Paeonia lactiflora Pall.）和川赤芍（Paeonia veitchii Lyncha）的干燥根。它在心血管保护方面显示出潜力。然而，其促血管生成机制仍知之甚少。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨PRR的促血管生成机制，并评估其作为血管闭塞性疾病治疗剂的潜力。材料与方法：采用网络药理学和分子对接 (molecular docking) 预测和分析PRR的潜在分子靶点。使用HUVECs评估PRR对细胞增殖、迁移、管形成和3D出芽的影响。此外，采用小鼠后肢缺血模型评估PRR在恢复血流和促进血管再生方面的治疗效果。结果：PRR剂量依赖性地增强内皮细胞增殖、迁移和管形成，同时将缺血肢体灌注恢复至基线的93.5%，并增加成熟血管密度。机制上，PRR上调VEGFR2和ADAM10，激活PI3K/AKT信号通路及ADAM10介导的血管重塑。shRNA干扰研究表明，ADAM10敲低将PRR的疗效降低一半，而其过表达则放大PRR驱动的血管生成。结论：PRR通过协调激活VEGFR2/PI3K/AKT生存信号和ADAM10介导的血管重塑，作为一种多靶点血管生成剂发挥作用，克服了单靶点疗法的局限性。这种天然产物的协同作用能够同时实现内皮出芽和血管稳定化，使PRR成为复杂闭塞性疾病的范式转变性候选药物。
